build.yml.eligibility: decides which jobs run from the pull request's file list through the GitHub API; replaced here by fixed outputs (relinker on, the pull request host set), so the path selection of the register-context, write-watch and edge-watch jobs is not reproduced
build.yml.register-context: selected by eligibility from changed paths; macOS native test; not reproduced (run it by hand if core/libs/tests/register_context or libc changed)
build.yml.write-watch: selected by eligibility from changed paths; macOS native test; not reproduced
build.yml.edge-watch: selected by eligibility from changed paths; macOS native test; not reproduced
build.yml.linux: self-hosted runner and a full build; the fork gate (fork-ci) covers the build and tests
build.yml.windows: full MSYS2 build and test run (long); the fork gate (fork-ci) covers it

pr-intake.yml.intake: needs the GitHub API and write tokens (open PR limit by author history); cannot run on a branch

pr-labels.yml.labels: labels a real pull request through the GitHub API

progress-comment.yml.comment: posts a comment from a workflow_run on a real pull request
